scene: At a harbor tide station, a fictional chart keeper sets a weight-driven mechanical tide predictor; a descending weight, transmission and tide pointer organize the departure decision for a small boat visible beyond the open station.
title: Tide-window chart keeper

scene: On a stone observatory roof at blue hour, a fictional astronomer releases a wound mechanical lunar demonstrator. Its exposed spring-and-gear train turns a brass moon on an orbital arm while she compares its alignment with the rising real moon.
title: Rooftop lunar ephemeris keeper

scene: At a mountain caravan rest house, a fictional courier winds a portable route-drum map. The spring-driven roller advances a route beneath a fixed pointer as the courier plans the next pass, with the terrain visible through the open arch.
title: Caravan route-drum courier

scene: Inside a sailing ship chartroom at night, a fictional navigator winds a clockwork celestial globe; the visible gear train rotates star rings beneath a horizon hoop while moonlight and the deck opening connect her reading to the actual sea.
title: Shipboard stellar globe navigator

scene: At a covered canal departure pavilion before sunrise, a fictional attendant operates a counterweight-driven route table whose gear-linked brass boat marker advances between engraved stations; an arriving passenger boat supplies the visible practical context.
title: Journey departure-table attendant
